title: Dragon Vein Awakening
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji stepped into the Forbidden Grounds, a familiar figure emerged slowly from the darkness—it was someone he had believed dead long ago.

text.content:
Imperial City, Midnight.

Chen Ji snapped his eyes open, cold sweat soaking through his undershirt. The Tianji Record Fragment on his chest burned searingly hot, and a blurry scene flashed frantically through his mind—golden-red dragon qi churned beneath the earth, the sound of chains breaking was deafening, and there was a pale face imprisoned within a pillar of light.

It was Chen Nian.

His sister, at this very moment, was enduring unimaginable suffering.

Almost simultaneously, a dull roar echoed from the eastern outskirts of the imperial city. The ground trembled slightly, and the night watch guards on the city walls turned nervously toward the Forbidden Grounds—which had been the resting place of emperors throughout the dynasty's history—now pierced by a golden-red pillar of light shooting toward the heavens.

"The dragon vein has awakened..." Chen Ji murmured, his fingers already leaving prints on the Tianji Record's cover.

Mo Xiansheng's residual soul materialized, his voice echoing hauntingly: "Kid, did you sense that?"

"Her location." Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly cold. "Within the range Tianji Record can see, she's been deep within the dragon vein."

Mo Xiansheng was silent for a moment: "The dragon vein's core is a crucial point in Heaven's design. Your sister being imprisoned there is no coincidence. The Eye of Heaven... is waiting for you to walk into its trap."

Chen Ji rose abruptly, and from beyond the window, the imperial city's commotion could be faintly heard—soldiers mobilizing, citizens panicking, the entire city stirred awake by the dragon vein's anomaly.

He closed his eyes, and the Tianji Record Fragment flickered again. This time, the range of his vision extended—not three hours, but a blurry future shrouded in mist.

The piercing pain of Heavenly Fate consumption came from the depths of his soul, but the figure imprisoned within the pillar of light in the vision made it impossible for him to stop.

Chen Nian turned her head, as if gazing at him across the void of time, her lips moving soundlessly, uttering two words: "Don't come."

dialogue.content: "If I don't come, who will?" Chen Ji laughed softly, his smile utterly cold. "Sister, did you think all these years I've been arranging things outside... for whom?"

text.content:
Before he could finish, the communication jade slip in his sleeve suddenly burned hot. Taking it out, he saw Su Qingyao's message—"Forbidden Grounds sealed. Imperial edict says the dragon vein anomaly requires sacrifice to suppress. I heard three cultivators are the sacrifice, including one female cultivator."

Chen Ji's hand clenched tightly, the jade slip cracking faintly.

Sacrifice. Every time the dragon vein anomalies occur, the imperial dynasty demands human offerings. And Chen Nian... was already inside.

"Kid, stay calm." Mo Xiansheng's voice carried rare seriousness. "If you rush over now, you're walking to your death. The Forbidden Grounds are protected by the dynasty's foundations, let alone the Eye of Heaven surely laying multiple traps. You haven't even resolved the crisis with Ling Yuan—"

Chen Ji cut him off sharply: "My sister is waiting for me to die, and I should handle other matters first?"

For the first time, Mo Xiansheng fell silent.

At that moment, a crack suddenly appeared in the shadows of the inn room. Golden light poured through the rift, carrying a bloodline aura achingly familiar to Chen Ji.

A spatial-temporal rift.

Chen Tianming's phantom stepped out from the rift, his features even more blurred than before, as if about to dissipate at any moment. But in his eyes as he looked at Chen Ji, there was only urgency.

"Ji'er, you've been marked." Chen Tianming's voice came in fragments. "The letter in Ling Yuan's possession... is a trap. He wants to lure you to the imperial Forbidden Grounds, there to—"

"There, to complete the Eye of Heaven's sacrifice." Chen Tianming said through gritted teeth. "Your sister being imprisoned at the dragon vein's core is specifically to lure you there. She's not a prisoner—she's bait!"

Chen's pupils contracted sharply.

At this moment, all the clues connected—Ling Yuan's betrayal, the dynasty's sacrifice, the Eye of Heaven's arrangement... He thought he was the chess player, but he hadn't realized he was already the most crucial piece on the board.

Chen Tianming's phantom began trembling violently: "My time is running out... Ji'er, remember, the true secret of the Tianji Record isn't about foresight, but—"

Before he could finish, the rift suddenly contracted, swallowing his form. Chen Ji reached out to grasp him, only to touch emptiness.

Silence returned to the room, and only the commotion beyond the window and the searing heat of the Tianji Record against his chest proved none of this was an illusion.

choice.prompt: The situation was clear—a lethal trap specifically designed for him. Ling Yuan had betrayed you, Chen Nian was the bait, the imperial Forbidden Grounds was the execution ground. But your sister is there. What will you do?

choices.text: Sneak into the Forbidden Grounds alone
choices.description: Damn the traps! My sister is suffering; every moment means more pain for her. Even if a dragon's pool and tiger's den lie ahead, I will charge in!
choices.visible_cost: May trigger Ling Yuan's preset trap, exposing the existence of the Tianji Record
choices.visible_reward: Buy time and rescue Chen Nian before the enemy completes their arrangement
choices.risk_hint: Deep solo infiltration; if there are ambushes, there will be no escape route

text.content:
Chen Ji changed into night attire, hiding the Tianji Record Fragment close to his body. He pushed open the window—night was as dark as ink, but in the direction of the imperial Forbidden Grounds, faint golden-red light flickered.

He notified no one—not Su Qingyao, not Ye Qing, not even Mo Xiansheng. In this game, he chose to play alone.

"Ling Yuan wants to watch me enter the board?" he murmured, a cold smile curling his lips. "Then let him see whether this piece can overturn the entire chessboard."

dialogue.content: His figure flickered and vanished into the night.

choices.description: Impulsiveness is suicide. Su Qingyao has influence in the imperial city, and Ye Qing's demonic path mist can conceal aura. Contact them first to improve the odds of success.
choices.visible_cost: Takes time to arrange, Chen Nian may suffer additional hours
choices.visible_reward: Gain ally support, increase success rate, reduce risk

text.content:
Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcing himself to calm down. He took out the communication jade slip and sent emergency summons to Su Qingyao and Ye Qing respectively.

"My sister's matter, you both know about it." His voice was flat, but those who knew him well could hear the suppressed fury beneath that calmness. "I need your help, but I won't let you go to your deaths. The Forbidden Grounds... I'll enter alone."

dialogue.content:
Two figures arrived at the inn one after another half an hour later. Su Qingyao's face was like still water, while Ye Qing showed a rare grave expression.

"I have intelligence on the Forbidden Grounds guards." Su Qingyao came straight to the point. "But the core area... you'll need to figure that out yourself."

Ye Qing handed over a pitch-black jade talisman: "The Demonic Path mist can help conceal your Heavenly Secrets aura for three hours. After this time, the Heavenly Eye will definitely lock onto you."
"That's enough." Chen Ji received the jade talisman, carefully placing it in his chest. He looked at the two women with unusual seriousness. "This kindness, I'll remember it."

choices.description: Ling Yuan wants to use this letter to lure me to the Forbidden Grounds? Fine, I'll turn his scheme against him. Let him think I've taken the bait, when in reality I've already uncovered all his cards and those of the Heavenly Eye.
choices.visible_cost: Need time to arrange counter-measures, might miss the best rescue opportunity
choices.visible_reward: Completely reverse the situation, turn the enemy against themselves
choices.risk_hint: If the enemy has other hidden手段, everything could be lost

text.content:
Chen Ji sat back down on the chair, the anxiety on his face slowly fading, replaced by a chilling calm that made one's heart tremble.

"What does Ling Yuan want to do with this letter?" he began自言自语, his fingers tapping lightly on the table. "He wants me to know—he's uncovered my secret, he wants to force me to the Forbidden Grounds to die."

Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out: "Then will you follow his lead?"

"Follow his lead?" Chen Ji laughed lowly. "No, I want him to think I've followed his lead."

He took out another jade slip from his chest—the fake intelligence jade slip he had prepared long ago, containing the "true" plan he had intentionally leaked to Ling Yuan.

"The real plan was never written on paper." He activated the jade slip, letting it dissolve into light particles in the air. "Now let Ling Yuan investigate. Every clue he finds will be poison I feed him."

And he would use this time to infiltrate the core of the Forbidden Grounds.

dialogue.content: "Let's go." He stood up, his gaze fixed on the direction of the Forbidden Grounds. "Before Ling Yuan realizes something is wrong, I must stand before Chen Nian."

text.content:
The third hour of the Yin period, outside the Forbidden Grounds of the imperial capital.

Chen Ji crouched on an eave, overlooking the scene below. The Forbidden Grounds guards were even more严密 than he had anticipated—not only imperial guards, but also three elders with profound, unfathomable auras guarding the entrance.

That was... the energy of Tianqing Sect techniques.

Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, a cold smile forming in his heart. Ling Yuan's reach was indeed far enough—even the Forbidden Grounds guards had been arranged with his own people.

dialogue.content:
He pressed the Demonic Path mist jade talisman against his brow center, and instantly, black mist enveloped his entire body. The aura of the Tianji Record was completely masked, and even his own danger sense became dulled.

"Three hours." He silently recited Ye Qing's instructions, his gaze scanning the guards' positions.

The east-side imperial guards had a thirty-breath gap during shift change; the western elder's aura was slightly unstable—he should be suffering from hidden injuries.

There. That's the spot.

text.content:
His身形 flashed, and Chen Ji glided past the guards' line of sight like a specter.

Just as he was about to slip through the west-side gap, that injured elder suddenly turned his head, his gaze like lightning sweeping toward his location.

Chen Ji's heart rate spiked—had he been discovered?

However, the elder's gaze only lingered on him for an instant before shifting elsewhere. The Demonic Path mist held steady.

Passing through the outer perimeter defense, the interior of the Forbidden Grounds was a silent mausoleum. Ancient pines and cypresses cast grotesque shadows under the moonlight, stone burial companions from emperors of past dynasties scattered across the ground.

But Chen Ji had no mood to appreciate these.

His only objective was one—the Dragon Vein Core.

The Tianji Record Fragment began剧烈跳动, guiding his direction. Ahead, a golden-red pillar of light shot straight up into the clouds, illuminating half the night sky.

There—that was where Chen Nian was.

The deeper he went, the more Chen Ji felt an invisible pressure surge like a tide. That was the suppression of Heavenly Will—even through the concealment of Demonic Path mist, that will continued to constantly probe and pry.

Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out: "Kid, you've entered the Dragon Vein domain now. Here, the Heavenly Eye's perception is magnified countless times. Your time... is running out."

Chen Ji did not answer, only quickening his pace.

Passing through the final stone gate, his vision suddenly opened up.

A massive underground altar appeared before him, and at its center, a golden pillar of light firmly locked a slender figure in place. Chen Nian floated within the light column, eyes tightly closed, her complexion deathly pale as paper, a trace of dried blood still at the corner of her lips.

Chen Ji's heart felt as if gripped tightly by someone's hand.

"Chen Nian!" he blurted out, his voice echoing in the vast altar.

The girl within the light slowly opened her eyes.

Those once clear, spirited pupils were now dim and lifeless, but upon seeing Chen Ji, a sudden flash of alarm streaked through them.

She mouthed silently: "Go... leave quickly..."

But Chen Ji had already seen the runes carved below the pillar. Those were ancient prohibitions—once someone touched the light column, the runes would trigger, and the Heavenly Eye's consciousness would immediately descend.

This was an unsolvable deadly ground.

choice.prompt: Chen Nian was right before his eyes, yet firmly locked by the ancient prohibition. Touch the pillar, and the Heavenly Eye descends; don't touch, and he can only watch helplessly as his sister continues to suffer. What would you do?

choices.description: What Heavenly Eye, what ancient prohibition—after all these years of chess-playing across the world, can't even save my own sister? I might as well confront this so-called Heavenly Will head-on!
choices.visible_cost: Directly trigger the Heavenly Eye's descent, confront this transcendent existence face-to-face
choices.visible_reward: Might interrupt the prohibition and rescue Chen Nian
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye's power far exceeds imagination, possible immediate death

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji fiercely mobilized his True Qi, both palms striking out simultaneously, hitting the light column!

"Break for me—!"

The golden light column剧烈摇晃, runes began flashing frantically. At the same time, a pressure beyond the senses came rushing from all directions, as if the entire heavens were casting angry gazes upon him.

An ancient, majestic voice exploded within the altar: "Insignificant creature, how dare you pry into Heavenly Secrets?"

text.content:
A giant eye, condensed from pure Heavenly Dao will, slowly opened above Chen Ji's head, its pupil reflecting his figure. That gaze was cold and aloof, as if looking at an ant about to be crushed.

Chen Ji felt his True Qi being suppressed by an invisible force, and even the Tianji Record Fragment let out a pained tremor.

This was the pressure of the Heavenly Dao's Eye—a truly transcendent existence.

But he did not retreat; instead, he grinned: "A transcendent existence? Hmph, let's see if you have the ability to block my strike!"

At that moment, Chen Nian inside the pillar of light abruptly opened her eyes, a resolute gleam flickering within.

"Brother, don't worry about me—!"

She opened her mouth and bit off her own tongue!

Blood gushed forth, dyeing the entire pillar of light crimson. The talismans began to twist violently, and the power of the forbidden formation weakened visibly—

She was using her own life force to buy Chen Ji the final chance!

choices.description: The opportunity Chen Nian bought with her life cannot be wasted. If the Heavenly Dao's Eye is this powerful, it must have weaknesses. I need time to analyze the structure of this forbidden formation.
choices.visible_cost: Chen Nian's life is continuously draining; every second is torment.
choices.visible_reward: Find the key to breaking the forbidden formation, avoid direct confrontation.
choices.risk_hint: If the Heavenly Dao's Eye takes the initiative to attack, I will lose time to think.

text.content:
Chen Ji forcefully suppressed the impulse in his heart, forcing himself to calm down.

The time Chen Nian bought for him was precious beyond measure.

He began observing the structure of the light pillar—talismans, energy flow, the core of the forbidden formation... The Tianji Record Fragment on his chest grew slightly warm, rapidly transmitting this information to him.

Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out: "Found it. The core of the forbidden formation is not on the light pillar, but underground—at the Dragon Vein node. If we can work from there, the formation will naturally collapse."

dialogue.content:
"Dragon Vein node..." Chen Ji murmured, his gaze sweeping across the altar.

Indeed, on the ground at the southeastern corner, there was a slightly raised stone platform, faintly emanated a different aura from the surrounding area—it was the convergence point of Dragon Vein spiritual energy.

"I understand." He murmured quietly, "This forbidden formation uses Dragon Vein power as its source. To break it, I must work from the Dragon Vein node."

He retrieved a formation disk from his bosom—one he had obtained years ago at an ancient ruin—the "Reverse Dragon Formation," specially designed to disrupt the flow of Dragon Vein spiritual energy.

He had thought he would never need it in this lifetime, never mind that it would be useful today.

text.content:
The moment the formation disk was activated, the entire altar began to tremble. The flow of Dragon Vein spiritual energy was forcibly altered, and the energy supply to the light pillar started becoming unstable.

But the will of the Heavenly Dao's Eye also sensed this.

That ancient giant eye abruptly turned toward Chen Ji, its pressure crushing down like a mountain: "Insignificant trick!"

A cold smile curved Chen Ji's lips: "Whether it's an insignificant trick or not, you don't decide."

He abruptly stepped forward, pouring all his True Qi into the formation disk: "Explode!"

A thunderous roar shattered the air as the Reverse Dragon Formation detonated one corner of the Dragon Vein node. The light pillar, losing its support, began to shake violently—

The first crack appeared on the forbidden formation binding Chen Nian!

dialogue.content: "Brother!" Chen Nian exclaimed in惊喜, but then she saw something, her face turning pale: "Watch your back—!"

choices.description: Mo Xiansheng is the guardian of the Tianji Record; he knows too many secrets. Now is the time to use all his power—even if it means he will dissipate completely.
choices.visible_cost: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul may thus dissipate completely, never able to help Chen Ji again.
choices.visible_reward: Gain Mo Xiansheng's full knowledge blessing, have a chance to turn the tide.
choices.risk_hint: Lose the most important master-level figure.

dialogue.content:
"Mo Xiansheng!" Chen Ji hesitated no longer, his voice steady: "I know you still have many secrets you haven't told me. Now, I need you to reveal all your hidden cards."

Mo Xiansheng was silent for a moment; the voice of his remnant soul carried a rare sigh: "Young man, are you sure? Once I动用全部力量, this wisp of remnant soul will dissipate completely."

"I'm sure." Chen Ji's voice had not the slightest hesitation, "For Chen Nian, I'm willing to give anything. Including you."

text.content:
Mo Xiansheng let out a long laugh: "Good! Good, willing to give everything for Chen Nian! You are indeed someone I recognized!"

The Tianji Record Fragment suddenly erupted with dazzling golden light; Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul burst from the book, transforming into a stream of light that merged into Chen Ji's brow center.

In that instant, Chen Ji felt his Mental Sea overwhelmed by a flood of information—the true secrets of the Tianji Record, the memories of prophetic seers through the ages, methods to break the Heavenly Dao forbidden formation...

He knew everything.

"So that's how it is..." he murmured, understanding flickering in his eyes, "The true power of the Tianji Record is not to foresee the future, but to—"

"Rewrite causality."

Chen Ji's eyes snapped open as he formed a seal with both hands—a technique never seen before.

A flicker of astonishment flashed in the giant pupil of the Heavenly Dao's Eye: "This is... impossible! How do you know this technique—"

"Because the moment you left the Tianji Record in this world, you were destined to be counteracted." Chen Ji's body began to emanate an aura completely opposite to the Heavenly Dao's will, "All the prophetic seers through the ages were your chess pieces, but the master of the Tianji Record never was."

His voice grew louder: "Now, let me show you—what the true Tianji Record can do!"

A brilliant golden light shot from his palm, striking directly at the core of the light pillar—

Not to destroy, but to rewrite.

The talismans on the light pillar began to reverse, and the forbidden formation started to collapse.

Chen Nian's body slowly began to descend.

dialogue.content:
"Chen Nian!" Chen Ji caught his falling sister, clutching her tightly in his arms.

Chen Nian opened her weak eyes, looking at this familiar yet strange face, tears streaming down: "Brother... it really is you..."

"It's me." Chen Ji's voice was somewhat choked, but more than that, it was heartache, "I'm sorry, big brother came late."

text.content:
However, the tender reunion of the siblings lasted only a few breaths.

The Heavenly Dao's Eye's fury crushed down like a tangible force: "A mere ant dares to rewrite the causality arranged by this One—"

That giant eye suddenly expanded, golden pupils brewing the power to destroy everything: "You shall all die here!"

Chen Ji held Chen Nian, feeling his sister trembling in his arms. She was too weak—even standing was impossible, let alone running.

"Go!" Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul's final voice rang out in Chen Ji's mind before dissipating: "On the east side of the altar, there is a hidden passage I left as a backup plan—quick!"

Chen Ji hesitated no longer; he gathered Chen Nian up and charged eastward.

Behind them, the Heavenly Dao's Eye's attack crashed down, and the entire altar trembled violently. Golden light devoured everything, transforming the place where they had stood into scorched earth.

But Chen Ji had already rushed into the hidden passage.

In the darkness, he ran desperately, Chen Nian in his arms as light as a feather.

After running for who knows how long, he finally burst out of the hidden passage.

Night wind rushed toward him, carrying a hint of moisture. They appeared by a small river on the outskirts of the imperial city; all was silent around.

Chen Ji knelt on one knee, gasping for breath. Chen Nian lay in his arms, having fallen into unconsciousness.

"We succeeded..." he murmured, but then frowned.

The power of the Demonic Path Mist Jade Talisman had already dissipated, and his Tianji Record aura was frantically leaking outward. Worse still—the Tianji Record Fragment was emitting an ear-piercing warning sound.

A powerful expert was approaching.

Chen Ji abruptly looked up and saw a figure slowly emerging from the darkness.

It was a figure he knew all too well—the former Sect Master of Tianqing Sect, Ling Yuan.

Ling Yuan's face held a faint smile; his gaze fell on the unconscious Chen Nian, the smile deepening: "Chen Ji, Chen Ji, I indeed did not misjudge you. You schemed across the world, and in the end, you walked into the net for the sake of a woman."

He clapped lightly: "Touching sibling affection. Unfortunately—neither of you is going anywhere."

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji slowly stood up, positioning himself between Chen Nian and the newcomer. There was not a trace of fear on his face; instead, a cold smile curved his lips: "Ling Yuan, you think you've won?"

Ling Yuan raised an eyebrow: "Oh? Could you still have hidden cards? Don't forget, the True Qi in your body has been suppressed by the Heavenly Dao's Eye; you can't even use the Tianji Record—"

"Indeed." Chen Ji interrupted him, "But I never said the Tianji Record was my only card."

In his hand, a jet-black jade talisman quietly appeared—the backup jade talisman Ye Qing had given him, containing the power of a single strike from the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path.

text.content:
Ling Yuan's expression shifted slightly: "A demonic path artifact? Are you colluding with the demonic path?"

"Colluding?" Chen Ji laughed lightly, "Ling Yuan, after you were abandoned by the Tianji Record, you joined the Heavenly Dao Eye and became its lackey. I was simply using the power of the demonic path against you—we're both the same."

He activated the jade talisman, and dark mist began to coil around him: "This strike was originally reserved for the Heavenly Dao Eye. But since you're so eager to die—I'll grant your wish."

A flicker of apprehension flashed in Ling Yuan's eyes, but it was quickly replaced by malice: "You think a single jade talisman can deal with me?"

"Why not try and see?"

Just as both sides stood at daggers drawn, a sharp sword aura came hurtling from the distance, aimed directly at Ling Yuan's heart!

Ling Yuan's expression changed drastically as he leaped backward. The sword aura grazed past his shoulder, slicing off several strands of white hair.

"Ling Yuan, as the former Sect Master of Tianqing Sect, how could you slaughter your own disciples?"

Su Qingyao's figure swept out from the night, sword in hand, her face like frost. Behind her followed several figures—all Inner Disciples of Tianqing Sect.

"Su Qingyao?" Ling Yuan narrowed his eyes. "What are you doing here?"

"What am I doing?" Su Qingyaosneered,"I am the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow of Tianqing Sect. When the sect has a traitor, of course I must cleanse the门户!"

The situation reversed abruptly.

Ling Yuan's expression turned chillingly dark. His gaze swept between Chen Ji and Su Qingyao, weighing the balance of power.

In a one-on-one fight, he was confident he could take down Chen Ji. But adding Su Qingyao and several Inner Disciples...

"Fine, fine indeed." Ling Yuan laughed coldly. "Today's matter, this one will remember. Chen Ji, do you think saving your sister solves everything? Let me tell you—the true storm has only just begun."

His form began to fade and blur, as if he might dissipate at any moment: "The accounts between us will be settled eventually."

With that, his figure vanished completely into the night.

After Ling Yuan departed, Chen Ji finally relaxed, his body swaying as he nearly collapsed.

Su Qingyao acted quickly, supporting him: "Are you alright?"

Chen Ji shook his head: "I'm fine... just a bit tired."

He looked down at the still-unconscious Chen Nian in his arms, and exhaustion in his eyes gave way to tenderness: "Worth it, to be able to be this tired just once."

Su Qingyao watched his expression, her heart full of mixed emotions. This man... as she had thought, he was never as simple as he appeared on the surface.

"Let's find a safe place to settle first." Su Qingyao suppressed her complex emotions. "With the Dragon Vein stirring, the Dynasty will surely search the entire city. Your aura has been exposed—you can't stay in the imperial capital any longer."

Chen Ji nodded: "I know a place..."

Just then, Chen Nian stirred in his arms and let out a weak murmur: "Brother... don't go... don't leave me..."

Chen Ji's heart felt as if pierced by a needle. He gently patted her back: "I'm not going anywhere, brother isn't going anywhere."

Su Qingyao watched this scene and suddenly felt that this man, usually so calculating, was now fragile like a child.

After settling Chen Nian, Chen Ji walked out of the room alone.

In the night sky, the golden-red pillar of light from the Dragon Vein direction had dissipated, but the turmoil in the imperial capital showed no sign of stopping. The imperial guards were searching house by house, and the entire city had fallen into panic.

He stood on the eaves, gazing toward the Forbidden Grounds.

The Heavenly Dao Eye, Ling Yuan, the Dynasty... and that always-lurking mastermind in the shadows. These enemies were stronger and more insane than he had imagined.

But he would not back down.

Because his sister had returned.

That was enough.

dialogue.content:
"Ling Yuan." He whispered the name, a cold light flickering in his eyes. "You think you've won? You think leading me to the Forbidden Grounds counts as success?"

He laughed softly: "No, that was only the beginning. The deals you made with the Heavenly Dao Eye—I will eventually make you confess with your own mouth—and then let the entire world see who the true traitor really is."

text.content:
Just as he was about to turn back to the room, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly began to pulse violently again.

A hazy image flashed through his mind—the truth of Chen Nian's imprisonment, the power of the Heavenly Fate Key sealed within her, and a chilling prophecy:

"If the seal of the Heavenly Fate Key is not unsealed, everything you cherish will turn to ashes in the Heavenly Dao Eye's chess game."

Chen Ji's expression darkened.

Saving Chen Nian was only the beginning.

The true trial still lay ahead.

And at the same time, in the depths of the Forbidden Grounds, a figure slowly emerged from the shadows. That person's face was half-hidden in darkness, but had Chen Ji been present, he would have been shocked—

Because that, was the figure of Mo Xiansheng.
